encounter.title: Этап 1 · Goblin King сбегает
encounter.notes: Stage 1 (STORY-001): first story beat. Goblin King (goblin-taunter art) holds center/TOP (side 0), 3 HP, passive, flee.afterHits 2 — unkillable by construction (only two N arrows exist on this board). After the 2nd hit he taunts and flees; the fight does NOT end — the player finishes the puzzle (clear the board, no other targets) for a board-clear win. Board 5x5 seed 1107. 0 damage.

encounter.title: Этап 2 · Цена ошибки
encounter.notes: Stage 2: Mistake cost & unlock order. Board 5x5 seed 1. 5 arrows. Target at center/TOP (side 0), 2 HP. Free arrows peel blocker so target can be defeated safely without blocked tap penalties. 0 damage.

encounter.title: Этап 3 · Давление таймера
encounter.notes: Stage 3: Timer pressure. Board 5x5 seed 4. 7 arrows. Target at center/TOP (side 0), 3 HP, ATTACK IN 4 dmg 2. Clean 4-turn solve kills mob on turn 4 before retaliation. 0 damage.

encounter.title: Этап 4 · Два врага одновременно
encounter.notes: Stage 4: Multi-enemy priority. Board 6x6 seed 282. Primary slow enemy center/TOP (side 0, IN 5), secondary urgent enemy RIGHT (side 1, IN 3). Focusing East first kills urgent enemy on turn 2 (0 damage). Wrong path (focusing North) results in East attacking for 2 damage.

encounter.title: Этап 5 · Босс Goblin Shaman

phases.label: Phase 2: Teleports East, begins CAST, Rotate grant

encounter.notes: Stage 5: Goblin Shaman boss. Phase 1 remains 3 HP on TOP. After teleport to EAST he now has 3 HP (one more than the previous tune), immediately enters interruptible CAST IN 3 with the existing cast pose + pulsing cast telegraph, and grants +1 Rotate. Interrupting the cast switches him to the normal attack cycle. Win still awards +2 shared Rotate. USER PLAYTEST TUNING: HP/timers remain provisional.
